response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, s.instownpct AS ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), scored AS (SELECT ownership, AVG(ownership) OVER (PARTITION BY order_type_mix) AS mix_baseline, AVG(ownership) OVER () AS overall_average FROM units) SELECT AVG(ownership) AS average_ownership, AVG(ownership / mix_baseline) AS average_relative_to_mix_baseline, AVG(ownership - overall_average) AS average_excess_over_overall FROM scored WHERE ownership > overall_average;
